parity_gate.within_variant_rule: Repeated responses for each case must have one status, exact body hash, result order, and SVG availability.
parity_gate.cross_variant_rule: Control and treatment must have equal status, exact body hash, result order, and SVG availability for every case.

recommendation_measurement.task: Choose an icon for application settings.

publication_limits.performance_failure_action: Complete the remaining safe diagnostic phases, block publication, and record the failed surface.

safety_stop_conditions: control and treatment response parity differs
private data or credentials appear in logs or artifacts
an unapproved external call or mutation occurs
a deployed isolated function differs from implementation commit 8ba345fa9
required_stage_evidence: worker state and worker request ordinal
query variant and candidate row counts
candidate SVG and approximate payload characters
allowed_external_mutations: apply only migration 20260714120000 through the hash-pinned runner
repair only migration history version 20260714120000 after SQL success
deploy implementation commit 8ba345fa9 to mcp-search-v2-control once
deploy implementation commit 8ba345fa9 to mcp-search-v2-treatment once
insert the normal synchronous search audit rows generated by the fixed internal measurement requests
delete mcp-search-v2-control after measurement or a safety stop
delete mcp-search-v2-treatment after measurement or a safety stop
allowed_read_only_actions: list hosted functions and npm tags before and after
export only public-safe search_stage_timing records for the measurement window
prohibited_actions: repair of any older migration history

rollback.sql_failure: The transaction rolls back. Do not repair migration history or deploy either endpoint.
rollback.repair_failure_after_sql_success: Verify the batched function and retry only the exact history repair. Do not rerun the SQL by assumption.
rollback.safety_stop: Delete both isolated endpoints immediately and record the stop. Leave production functions and npm unchanged.
rollback.performance_failure: Finish the remaining safe diagnostic phases, delete both isolated endpoints, record the failed publication gate, and leave production functions and npm unchanged.
rollback.successful_measurement: Delete both isolated endpoints. Any beta or publication step requires a separate owner approval.
